summary: This class examines the custom of Halab regarding chalav Yisrael and buying dairy products from non-Jews. It discusses the rulings of Hakham Yosef Sithon in Vaylaqet Yosef concerning sahlab and 'anbar buz, alongside the leniency of the Peri Hadash. It also details how rabbinic authorities in Halab, Argentina, and New York addressed milk milked by non-Jews.
